purpose: Internal editorial regression benchmark for routing a communicative goal to a Metkagram reasoning intent and reusable frame. It is not evidence of learning efficacy or a statistically independent model benchmark.

method.core: Two natural-language cases per intent: one English and one Russian.
method.near_neighbor: One additional English case per intent, written to distinguish adjacent intents that share the same reasoning move.
method.grading: Primary intent, reasoning move, and a set of editorially acceptable frames are checked at ranked cutoffs. Multiple frames may be valid.
method.limitations: Cases and taxonomy are curated by the same project. Treat the results as a regression and editorial-quality signal, not external validation.
